question: Find the area of the parallelogram defined by adjacent sides $\vec{a} = 2\hat{i} + 3\hat{j} + \hat{k}$ and $\vec{b} = 4\hat{i} - \hat{j} + 5\hat{k}$.
explanation:
Step 1: The area of the parallelogram is given by the magnitude of the cross product:

$\text{Area} = |\vec{a} \times \vec{b}|$

Step 2: Calculate $\vec{a} \times \vec{b}$:

$\vec{a} \times \vec{b} = \begin{vmatrix} \hat{i} & \hat{j} & \hat{k} \\ 2 & 3 & 1 \\ 4 & -1 & 5 \end{vmatrix}$

$= \hat{i}(3 \times 5 - 1 \times (-1)) - \hat{j}(2 \times 5 - 1 \times 4) + \hat{k}(2 \times (-1) - 3 \times 4)$

$= \hat{i}(15 + 1) - \hat{j}(10 - 4) + \hat{k}(-2 - 12)$

$= 16\hat{i} - 6\hat{j} - 14\hat{k}$

Step 3: Compute the magnitude:

$|\vec{a} \times \vec{b}| = \sqrt{(16)^2 + (-6)^2 + (-14)^2}$

$= \sqrt{256 + 36 + 196}$

$= \sqrt{488}$

$= 2\sqrt{122}$

Therefore, the area of the parallelogram is $2\sqrt{122}$ square units.
